_comment: Recorded state of the sources this site is built from. scripts/check-reg-versions.mjs compares the live sources against these values weekly (.github/workflows/reg-watch.yml) and fails — emailing the maintainer — if anything changed. After reviewing the affected pages, run `node ./scripts/check-reg-versions.mjs --update` and commit.
